interpretation: differential rank_pct adjustment for FBA sellers during seller-disappearance transitions; in the final specification this object is treated as a decomposition component of the broader turnover-premium design
seller fixed effects absorb time-invariant seller quality and transition fixed effects absorb shocks common to a pair of consecutive markets
seller disappearance is observed disappearance from the offer list, not verified random stock-out, so the design is stronger than static OLS but still observational
the dynamic vacancy model is re-estimated by baseline rank tier to check whether the FBA-vacancy response is concentrated near the economically more visible top of the ranking
the final dynamic mechanism tests whether FBA status is associated with stronger rank adjustment during seller turnover; the clean local above-turnover channel is not the primary claim
